name: @voxgig/struct-js
description: JSON data structure manipulations — JavaScript port

scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm i && npm test
scripts.repo-tag: REPO_VERSION=`node -e "console.log(require('./package').version)"` && echo TAG: javascript/v$REPO_VERSION && git commit -a -m javascript/v$REPO_VERSION && git push && git tag javascript/v$REPO_VERSION && git push --tags;
scripts.repo-publish: npm run clean && npm i && npm run repo-publish-quick
scripts.repo-publish-quick: npm run inject-version && npm run test && npm run doc && npm stage publish --access public --registry https://registry.npmjs.org && npm run repo-tag
scripts.repo-publish-dry: npm run clean && npm i && npm run repo-publish-dry-quick
scripts.repo-publish-dry-quick: npm run inject-version && npm run test && npm run doc && npm stage publish --dry-run --access public --registry https://registry.npmjs.org
